title: The Late Slip You Folded Small
youtube_title: The Late Slip You Folded Small | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A plain truth is kinder than a tidy secret.
summary: At a workshop bench of wood, glue, and labels, Opal is tangled up with a late note you folded small and almost hides it. Opal tells Uncle Idris the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
